text:
elaine: Got vendor pen-test intake this morning. They flagged: (A) overly broad service role used by CI, (B) gaps in KMS audit evidence for a sensitive key, (C) missing request/response logs for a tiny subset of prod traffic. Attached report: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-pt-vendor. Need to assemble minimal artifacts for retest and avoid org-wide IAM churn. Suggestions?

samir: I can stand up a timebound assessor role. Proposal: create role `pt-assessor-<ticket>` assumable only by vendor principals for a 2 hour window. Policy will scope to only the single S3 prefix + kms:DescribeKey + kms:GetKeyRotationStatus. No kms:Decrypt. Example policy I plan to use:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:GetObject"],"Resource":["arn:aws:s3:::sec-evidence/prod-pt/*"]},
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:DescribeKey","kms:GetKeyRotationStatus"],"Resource":["arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/EXAMPLEKEY"]}
  ]
}
```
I'll also include conditions to restrict assume-role by external ID and source IP ranges where possible. I'll open a CR and tag @infra-oncall for one SRE reviewer.

olga: I'll build the artifact bundle. Plan:
- CloudTrail slice for the key and the target service: 2025-07-20..2025-07-26
- KMS commands to prove rotation state and aliases: `aws kms get-key-rotation-status`, `aws kms list-aliases`, `aws kms list-grants`
- Application access logs for the sampled traces (redact PII).
I'll create an index CSV mapping each finding -> filename + redaction notes. Upload will be to `s3://sec-evidence/prod-pt/` with presigned links valid 5 days. Zip name: pt_evidence_1775009999.zip

mike: Prefer pulling the request/response traces from Datadog & Loki instead of raw app buckets. I can export a 1% sample window containing the missing traces and produce a redacted HAR for the vendor. Query I'm going to run: `service:redwood-api AND http.status_code:[200 TO 499] AND @trace_id:` then filter by the endpoints the report mentions.

security-bot: Ticket SEC-2025-999 created and linked to this thread. Reminder: any role that touches S3/KMS must include a photo ID check with the vendor and recorded session policy. See internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/security/pt-handling

samir: One nuance: vendor asked for grant history for the key back to 2023. Our `aws kms list-grants` only returns current grants. For historical evidence I can pull CloudTrail events where `eventName` is CreateGrant/RevokeGrant and include those JSON events. Will add that to the index.

elaine: Good catch. Also vendor asked for proof of when the key rotation was last enabled. Olga please include `aws kms get-key-rotation-status` output and a screenshot of the KMS console key details (blur account IDs).

olga: Will do. For CloudTrail slice I will run: `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/EXAMPLEKEY --start-time 2023-01-01 --end-time 2025-07-26` and save output as `cloudtrail_kms_events.json`.

infra-oncall: Quick note from SRE: keep the change window early morning UTC to lower traffic and ensure rollback path is a single revoke action. If you need a host-level change, tag me and we'll schedule a canary.

samir: A few operational details I'll include in the CR: exact role ARN, assume-role external ID, start/end timestamps (ISO8601), and explicit revoke command: `aws iam delete-role-policy --role-name pt-assessor-1775009999 --policy-name pt-s3-kms-read` then `aws iam delete-role --role-name pt-assessor-1775009999`.

mike: After I export the Datadog slice, I'll post the query and a small redaction script. Also will attach a screenshot of the trace sample and a short note explaining how it maps to the vendor finding (filename: trace_sample_1775009999.json).

elaine: Proposed retest slot: Thu 2025-07-31 08:00 UTC (we'll give vendor 72h notice). If artifacts and CR are ready by Tue 2025-07-29 EOD, we lock that slot. If anything blocks, escalate to @security-bot and @infra-oncall.

olga: Upload ETA: Tue 2025-07-29 15:00 UTC. I'll post presigned links and the CSV index in this thread when done.

security-bot: SEC-2025-999 status: awaiting artifacts. Reminder: include hash (sha256) for each artifact and the index must be signed by an eng-security approver.

elaine: Recap (quick): Samir -> create role + CR + grant history export; Olga -> artifact bundle + presigned links + sha256s + index; Mike -> aggregator slice + redaction notes; infra-oncall -> SRE review on CR; security-bot -> ticket tracking. We'll reconvene here once presigned links posted. Thanks :raised_hands:
